title: DP (Different Profile) branch: lay out the frozen-encoder arrays of the FLAG train set and MAV-Celeb v1/v2 as the DP scripts read them

origin.basis: file list of Experiment/XJF-01/xjf.py lines 54-77 and extract_eval.py lines 39, 60, 79 (reads under <team repo>/kaggle/output/)

verify.rule: equal when the producing stages are skipped with the stored arrays (strict by default outside FF_MODE=train); rebuilt arrays (GPU, mode (a)) may differ: reported. Shape / dtype mismatches always stop the stage

env_spec: docker/requirements-dp-local.txt (team CPU machine: Python 3.14.0, torch 2.12.1+cpu, numpy 2.3.5, pandas 3.0.5, insightface 2.0, onnxruntime 1.31.1, speechbrain 1.1.2; S8 E3)

env_overrides.DP_FEATS_STRICT: 1 = stop when a laid-out file differs from the submission array, 0 = report only; default 1, except in FF_MODE=train (mode (a): the producing GPU stages are re-run). Shape and dtype of the .npy files are always checked (a wrong source bundle stops the stage)
